scope: 8 Rust modules (1772 LOC), worker.py (265 LOC), prompt.md; cargo clippy clean; zero tests

findings.title: No permission model: accept() is model self-approval; no read-only mode; --yolo unguarded
edit() truncates then writes; kill/crash/disk-full destroys target file
Stream-finish heuristic accepts truncated SSE responses as complete; partial tool-call plans executed
messages() strips reasoning_content from history at turn boundaries; prompt cache invalidated every turn
Sandbox env deny-list leaks SSH_AUTH_SOCK/DATABASE_URL/DSN; /tmp writable enables SSH-agent hijack
3s settle() vs 30min checks; partial stdin writes corrupt worker protocol; stale-reply misalignment
Orphaned subprocesses: kill_on_drop kills only direct child; _exec groups survive worker SIGKILL
Nested/vendored .git writable -> hook planting executing later outside the sandbox
Zero tests, zero CI
Usage-or-nothing token accounting; len/4 estimator; fixed COMPACT_AT untied to model window
Consecutive context overflow hard-aborts turn; 'nothing to compact' stalls into abort
Blocking stty fork/exec every second and std::fs/process inside async turn on current_thread runtime
O(session) clone + re-serialization of full context per request; unbounded entries Vec
MAX_REQUESTS=200; one check-nudge; no repeated-tool-call or repeated-failure detection
Backoff without jitter; overflow classified by error-text substring sniffing
No pre-flight syntax/AST validation of edits; mixed-EOL files break old matching
AGENTS.md + SKILL.md descriptions injected uncapped; system prompt frozen at session creation
reasoning_content echoed back to provider on request
No panic hook / terminal restore guarantee; poisoned-mutex panic in Turn::drop during unwind
Repo-controlled air.toml check/fmt execute as user; localhost network allowed; --yolo silent
Request omits max_tokens, seed, parallel_tool_calls:false
load() swallows all config read errors; api_key file perms unchecked
findings.fix: classify ENOENT vs other errors; 0600 check

findings.title: Multi-file edit batches non-transactional; no rollback
SSE scan O(n^2) drain, uncapped buffer, multi-line data: events silently dropped

fingerprint() hashes mtime (phantom/missed changes); compact::tail cuts mid-line
